title: Advanced Botanical Compounds
summary: The standard reference. Indispensable to the serious collector. — H. Ambry

pages.text: Lay the leaf on dark cloth and {~say what it is not~}. Its true name {~rises along the vein~}, faint as watermark.
Scrape a little rind into the bowl. Root, stem and leaf {~each keep~} the {?ombrewort?}-memory of their soil, which this {~draws out as colour~}.
Breathe on the glass and hold it {~a hand above~} the pressed specimen. The living colour shows {~as it was in the field~}, and with it {~the habit of the plant~}.
What grows {~may be asked to stop~}, and what has stopped {~may be asked to go back into the ground~}. {~Small quantities only.~} It does not know {~where to end~}.
pages.authorNote: Outlier. Elara's accident and Hennie's misuse. Legible: "It does not know ... where to end".
